# betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_control (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `control_id` (String) The ID for the control. For field controls, this is the field reference name.
- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group to add the control to.
- `process_id` (String) The ID of the process.
- `work_item_type_reference_name` (String) The reference name of the work item type.

### Optional

- `contribution` (Block List, Max: 1) Contribution for the control. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--contribution))
- `is_contribution` (Boolean) A value indicating if the layout node is contribution or not.
- `label` (String) Label for the field.
- `metadata` (String) Inner text of the control.
- `order` (Number) Order in which the control should appear in its group.
- `read_only` (Boolean) A value indicating if the control is readonly.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `visible` (Boolean) A value indicating if the control should be hidden or not.
- `watermark` (String) Watermark text for the textbox.

### Read-Only

- `control_type` (String) Type of the control.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inherited` (Boolean) A value indicating whether this layout node has been inherited from a parent layout.
- `overridden` (Boolean) A value indicating whether this layout node has been overridden by a child layout.

<a id="nestedblock--contribution"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contribution`

Required:

- `contribution_id` (String) The id for the contribution.

Optional:

- `height` (Number) The height for the contribution.
- `inputs` (Map of String) A dictionary holding key value pairs for contribution inputs.
- `show_on_deleted_work_item` (Boolean) A value indicating if the contribution should be shown on deleted work item.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `read` (String)
